name: Playlist Genre Filter
author: William Raffety
description: Removes tracks of genres you choose (for example Christmas or Classical), or whose album title or file path matches a word you choose, from the playlists clustering creates. Navidrome only for now. Runs on a schedule or on demand, with a preview mode.

versions.changelog: Show the plugin in the sidebar (menu item no longer points at the settings endpoint, which core hides).
First release: genre checklist from Navidrome, album/path patterns, preview and apply modes, optional removal of playlists left too small, run log.
